Marta the Scholar works at a table buried in spellbooks, loose notes, and a crystal-bound codex. Gribbles Rindsworth lounges nearby with a tankard in hand, his sharp goblin eyes tracking every conversation from a seat close to Marta. Iron sconces and a stone fireplace cast steady amber light across the otherwise empty tavern.
